data.one_liner: Flutter widget that requires double back-button presses to close an app, route, or screen.
data.what_it_does: It wraps any widget and intercepts back button presses. Users must press the back button twice within a specified time window to successfully exit the screen or app, with support for custom messages, snackbars, and conditions.
use_when: You want to prevent accidental app exits when users press the back button on the home screen.
You need custom handling or warnings on the first back press before closing a route.
avoid_when: You are building for platforms or navigation flows where standard single back press is expected everywhere.
strengths: Supports custom actions, snackbars, and flashbars via callbacks
Includes customizable delay and conditional execution
weaknesses: Limited to back button interception use cases
data.minimal_example:
DoubleBack(
  message: "Press back again to close",
  child: Home(),
)
